_doc: PORT-P2 (2026-10-23): research portal registry seed, read only by vera/portal_registry.py. Registry entries are METADATA ONLY: no entry creates a fetchable host, network route or allowlist entry (fetch hosts stay in config/auto_acquire.json landing_route, config/wiki_ref_portal.json and the providers' own config). Status levels are COMPUTED, never stored: registered (listed here or imported), supported (its adapter exists in code), configured (supported AND its config probes pass against the LIVE acquisition/search config: config/auto_acquire.json and config/wiki_ref_portal.json, which drive the /ask acquisition chain in vera.search_providers.acquisition_search; config/vera_eval_run.json is reported separately as eval_configured), operational (configured AND a completed search within health.max_success_age_hours, and fewer than health.max_consecutive_failures failures since). A listed URL alone never makes a portal operational.

provenance.seed: VERA-DAR code and config at base 9d0d7643 + FRESH-1023 (adapters in vera/search_providers.py, vera/wiki_ref_portal.py); descriptive fields (category, domains, formats) from each portal's public documentation as understood by the implementer, not owner-verified

imports._note: Imported entries stay registered only (no adapter) unless existing_vera_portal names a seed portal, in which case the owner entry is merged into that portal (owner provenance, category and domains added). page_section is recorded as the research subject domain.

portals.name: DuckDuckGo Lite
portals.acquisition: identifier mapping (DOI/PMC/PubMed/arXiv/citation_doi) then the unchanged resolve, licence and fetch gates; other pages held as links
portals.licence_notes: result pages are not evidence; unclear-licence pages are HOLD (links only)
portals.security_notes: bot-challenge page is never evaded; shared daily query cap

portals.name: OpenAlex
portals.acquisition: DOI/PMCID to the Europe PMC open-access full-text route (unchanged gates)
portals.licence_notes: metadata CC0; content licence checked per document

portals.name: Europe PMC

related.relation: indexes overlapping biomedical literature; PubMed/PMC ids resolve through Europe PMC

portals.acquisition: Europe PMC open-access JATS full text (unchanged gates)
portals.licence_notes: query excludes ND licences; licence gate per document

portals.name: Directory of Open Access Journals
portals.acquisition: DOI to the unchanged resolver (no DOAJ full-text route)

portals.name: arXiv
portals.licence_notes: metadata CC0; preprints not peer reviewed; Europe PMC refuses preprints so acquisition yields nothing

portals.name: English Wikipedia (reference portal)
portals.acquisition: cited scholarly identifiers only, through the unchanged gates; Wikipedia text is never evidence

related.relation: PubMed ids found by other portals are looked up through Europe PMC; no PubMed adapter exists

health._calibration_note: UNCALIBRATED planner priors (no discovery_event history exists yet). 168 h = one week; 3 consecutive non-completed searches. Calibrate from the first two weeks of recorded discovery events (distribution of time between successes per portal).

store._bounds_note: UNCALIBRATED planner priors: SQLite busy timeout per statement and the bounded background queue (records beyond max_pending are dropped and logged, never awaited). Calibrate from dev write latency before enabling.
store._note: Off by default: production Postgres tables need the owner-approved 009 migration (db/migrations/pending, not applied). For dev, set enabled true and sqlite_path to a file under work/. The recorder never blocks or changes an answer.

definitions.relevant: relevance-qualified: the candidate passed the existing acquisition relevance and admission gates (inline outcome admitted, reused, or admitted-but-over-budget not_used). Topical match only; not evidence value.
definitions.valuable: valuable: ALL of (a) relevance-qualified, (b) full text acquired or reused with >=1 admitted chunk, (c) cited by >=1 claim the claim checker marked supported in an accepted answer, (d) no claim citing it marked unsupported (the checker's label also covers contradiction). Never availability, relevance or citation count alone.
definitions.freshness_qualified: the document's admitted passages assessed fresh by vera.freshness for this request
definitions.contradictory: at least one claim citing the document was marked unsupported by the claim checker (unsupported or contradicted); unknown (null) when no claim check ran
definitions._calibration_note: Definitions, not thresholds; version 1 is UNCALIBRATED against real outcomes. Revisit after reviewing a sample of valuable/non-valuable labels with the owner; bump version on any change and keep old rows labelled with their version.

selection._calibration_note: UNCALIBRATED planner priors (no history). epsilon 0.15 and min_trials 3 keep new and rarely used portals selectable; max_share 0.6 stops one portal holding position 2 in more than 60% of recent selections. Calibrate once >= 100 recorded requests per portal exist.
